phrase.zh: 稳定的闪烁，也是星体在转动。
phrase.en: A steady pulse can reveal a spinning star.

visual.zh: 星体旁的同心光环与双向光束，把有规律的脉冲画成可见的拍点。图中的光束方向和比例不对应具体脉冲星。
visual.en: Concentric rings and opposing beams turn regular pulses into visible beats. Beam angles and scale do not represent a particular pulsar.

background.zh: 脉冲星是一类快速旋转的中子星。它的辐射束随旋转扫过地球时，观测者会接收到重复的脉冲；脉冲间隔反映其自转，而不是星体本身一明一灭。
background.en: Pulsars are rapidly rotating neutron stars. As a radiation beam sweeps across Earth, observers receive repeated pulses. The intervals reflect rotation, rather than a star switching on and off.
